about: What a person decided after looking at each gun, for measuring it again (gun_mounts.py measure). The result of the
measuring is Tables/Weapons/GunMounts.csv; the game reads only that.
irons: the pieces of the gun's mesh that are its own iron sights (numbers as 'gun_mounts.py measure <gun> --pieces'
prints and draws them). Pieces that touch one of them and stand over the rail are taken with it unless grow is false.
hides: pieces that are glass the pack draws as solid metal (a built-in sight's lens): never drawn.
rail: where the top rail really begins and ends, cm from the gun's eye place along its sight line, when the flat
stretch the rule finds is not it.
grip, under: the stretch of the underside that takes a foregrip / a light, cm from the eye along the sight line.
Piece numbers hold while the model and the prefab's renderers stay as they are: after a change of either, look again.
